originalProposals.reason: Japanese tsu+nami = harbor wave is true, and TL/BIS (alon sa daungan / balod sa pantalan) match, but no current facet teaches etymology or harbor damage as tsunami science. G7-E-7 (earthquakes result in tsunamis that devastate shoreline communities) is not admitted (needs seafloor|seabed|displac or coast|shore|shallow|inundat). G7-E-5:tsunami-conditions is how underwater earthquakes may or may not generate tsunamis, not the name. G5-E-8:impacts (damage harbors) is weather-disturbance effects, not tsunamis. G7-E-3 community damage is earthquake magnitude. G3-F-8 wave is sending messages; G10-M-5 word is chemical equations. Potential G7-E-7 after a harbor/coastal-impact facet.

Whole-water-column vs wind-driven surface waves is real, and TL/BIS (alon/balod sa ibabaw vs tibuok tubig) match, but G7-E-7 is not admitted. G7-E-5 is generation conditions, not the wind-wave contrast. G6-F-5 ripple-tank investigation (crests/troughs/bend/reflect) is not taught and is not credited. G3-F-1 wind/water is making objects move. G5-L-4 table matches water column. Potential G7-E-7 or G6-F-5 after a tsunami-vs-wind-wave facet.

Deep-ocean tsunamis are fast and low (NOAA), and TL/BIS (kasimbilis ng jet / sama kapaspas sa jet plane; mababa/ubos) match, but no current facet teaches travel speed. G7-E-5 is how underwater earthquakes may or may not generate tsunamis, not jet-like speed. G6-F-6 is researching amplitude/frequency/wavelength/velocity as wave terms, not a jet-speed trivia value. G4-F-4 graphs and G7-E-1 plane/steep are swallows. G3-F-4 travel is sound transfer. Potential G7-E-5 or G6-F-6 after a deep-ocean tsunami-speed facet.

Deep-ocean tsunami amplitude is small, and TL/BIS (mababa/ubos; hindi mapansin/dili mamatikdan) match, but G7-E-7 is not admitted. G7-E-5 is generation conditions, not offshore height. G3-F-8 wave is sending messages. G8-E-9 ocean/sea is how water bodies affect typhoons. Potential G7-E-7 after an offshore-amplitude/shoaling facet.

Tsunamis are not caused by tides or the moon, and TL/BIS (taog/taob; buwan/bulan) match, but G7-E-7 is not admitted. G3-E-6/G3-E-8 moon are sky-object observation and how sky objects affect people's activities. G8-E-11 tides is not admitted. Fair-test/investigation 'same' hits (G4-E-3/G5-F-2/G7-M-10/G8-L-11) are not credited. Potential G7-E-7 or G8-E-11 after a tsunami-not-tide facet.

Tsunami danger from a strong inundation current (not just wave height) is real (NOAA), and TL/BIS (agos/sulog; tao at bahay / tawo ug balay) match, but G7-E-7:coastal-impact is not admitted (needs coast|shore|shallow|inundat). G7-E-5 is generation conditions. G3-E-5:danger is weather danger, not seismic sea waves. G6-F-5 height is a ripple-tank investigation and is not credited. G5-F-10 current is electromagnet current. Potential G7-E-7 after a current/inundation/houses coastal-impact facet.

A stem tuber with eyes is correct for potato, but kamote/sweet potato is a tuberous root, not a stem tuber with eyes (Ipomoea batatas). G5-L-7:tubers explicitly excludes sweet potato: (?=.*potato)(?=.*tuber)(?!.*sweet potato). G8-L-3:stem is the transport system, not storage. G3-F-7/G3-E-9 eye is sun/light safety. TL/BIS keep underground stem/eyes/kamote, so they repeat the error. Potential G5-L-7 after replacing kamote with potato.

Tuna are fast pelagic fish, and TL/BIS (pinakamabilis/labing paspas nga isda) match, but G3-L-4 outer body parts for movement/feeding is not admitted (needs leg/wing/fin-role patterns). G5-L-9 camouflage/mimicry is not admitted. G4-F-4 is constructing speed graphs (activity not credited). G7-F-6 is speed vs velocity. G9-M-10 sea of electrons. Potential G3-L-4 after fins/streamlined-body, or G5-L-9 after a speed-adaptation facet.

Tuna regional endothermy via a countercurrent heat-exchange system is real, and TL/BIS keep heat-exchange and warmer muscles. G5-L-9 camouflage/mimicry is not admitted. G6-L-8:water would swallow endothermy into generic abiotic water. G4-F-9/F-10 heat is energy forms/home uses. G7-F-9 warm is conduction/convection/radiation advantages; the card never names those modes. Potential G5-L-9 after a heat-exchange/endothermy adaptation facet.

Turmeric (luyang dilaw) is a traditional yellow cloth dye, and TL/BIS (pangkulay ng tela / tina sa panapton) match, but G3-M-1 matches cook only as a foil ('isn't just for cooking'), not the dye teaching. G6-M-4 mixtures is not taught. G3-E-9 cloth is sun-safety clothing. G5-L-7 rhizome is not admitted (needs 'rhizome'). G5-F-10 strong is electromagnet. Potential G5-L-7 after a rhizome/dye-use facet, or G3-M-1 after a local plant-dye example.

A turtle's shell is fused to its skeleton and used as armor, and TL/BIS (talukab/bagol; kalasag) match, but G3-L-4 outer body parts for move/feed is not admitted. G4-L-1:skeletal needs bone.*(support|protect). G5-L-9 camouflage/mimicry is not admitted. G8-M-2/G8-M-8 shell is electron shells. G3-E-5 danger is weather. Potential G3-L-4 or G4-L-1 after a shell/armor/protect facet.

Odonata predate dinosaurs (Carboniferous vs Triassic), and TL/BIS (tutubi/alindahaw; dinosaur) match, but G5-L-4:insects admits only the word insect without grouping characteristics (six legs/three tagmata). The classification-table activity is not taught and is not credited. G4-L-3:air fly is aerial-habitat classification; 'flying' is incidental age evidence. G9-E-6 needs eon|era|period or history/timescale. G5-E-10/G6-E-5 before is cyclone/volcano timing. Potential G5-L-4 after insect traits, or G9-E-6 after a fossil/deep-time insect facet.

Young dragonflies hunting underwater and eating tadpoles and tiny fish is a living-things-depend-on-one-another-for-food example, the G3-L-7 food-and-shelter facet. Environment also matches via water (underwater hunting) as the same interdependence competency. Not recovered to G4-L-3 (water is aquatic, but aerial also matches 'fly' in dragonfly). G4-L-5 tadpole is frog life-cycle, not prey. G3-L-3 young is reproduction, not hunting. G6-L-8 predat is not admitted. G9-L-7 hunt is extinction. TL butete / BIS uok keep tadpoles. Full EN/TL/BIS and both pools inspected; single identical card ID.

originalProposals.reason: Binaural localization of a jeepney horn is real, and TL/BIS (tainga/dalunggan; busina/bosina) match, but G3-F-4 how sound is made and transferred is not admitted. G3-F-7:loud-sound (ear) is harm/protection, not localization. G3-F-3 left-right is measuring position change of people/objects. Potential G3-F-4 after a two-ears/localization facet.

Binocular disparity yielding depth is real, and TL/BIS (lalim/giladmon; utak/utok) match, but G3-F-7/G3-E-9 eye is bright-light/sun safety. G3-F-5 see is everyday light sources. G3-L-4 outer body parts is not admitted. Potential G3-L-4 or G3-F-5 after a two-eyes/depth facet.

Kidneys are bean-shaped and retroperitoneal, and TL/BIS (bato hugis-balatong / kidney porma sa balatong; gulugod / bukog sa likod) match, but G8-L-2 digestion-excretion pairing is not admitted. G4-L-1 body systems are not admitted. G3-M-8 shap is making solids useful. Potential G8-L-2 after a kidney/excretion-function facet.

Type AB is codominant A and B antigens, not mixed bloods, and TL/BIS (sariling buong blood type / kaugalingon nga kompleto; antigen) match, but G6-L-1:blood matches 'carries' as circulatory transport, not antigens. The pictures/diagrams activity is not credited. G9-L-2 DNA/gene/chromosome/inherit is not admitted. G8-L-4 dominant/recessive is not admitted. Potential G8-L-4 or G9-L-2 after a blood-type/codominance facet.

AB+ as universal RBC recipient is the school-level rule, and TL/BIS keep AB+/AB- and universal recipient. G10-L-2 positive/negative is homeostasis feedback. G6-F-4 receiver is waves. G3-M-2 question is investigation asking. G6-L-1 blood is not admitted. Potential G6-L-1 or G8-L-4 after an ABO/Rh recipient facet.

Hubble spiral/elliptical/irregular types are standard, and TL/BIS keep those names, but no G3-10 galaxy competency exists. G3-M-8 shap is making solids useful. G3-L-4 fin matches defined. G3-F-2 shape is movement factors. Potential new G9-E/G7-E galaxy-types facet.

Weak tropical depressions often lack a clear eye/eyewall, and TL/BIS (mata at eyewall / mata ug eyewall; tropical depression) match, but G8-E-7 formation conditions (warm|moist|Coriolis) are not admitted. G5-E-10 before/during/after cyclone weather is not admitted. G3-E-5:danger storm is weather danger to people, not storm structure. G3-E-9 eye is sun safety. Potential G8-E-7 or G5-E-10 after an eyewall/intensity-structure facet.

Typhoon/hurricane/cyclone are regional names for the same storm type, and TL/BIS keep those names, but G8-E-7 (how typhoons develop / why PH is prone) is not admitted. G5-E-10 cyclone stages are not admitted. G3-E-4 change is daily weather patterns. Fair-test 'same' hits are not credited. Potential G8-E-7 after a regional-name/same-structure facet.

The eyewall is the strongest inner ring and rainbands are weaker outer bands, and TL/BIS (pinakaloob at pinakamalakas / pinakasulod ug pinakakusog) match, but G4-E-4 rain is weather-element identification, not typhoon anatomy. G3-E-5 storm is weather danger. G3-M-1 rain is local everyday events. G3-E-9 eye is sun safety. Potential G8-E-7 after a typhoon-parts/eyewall-rainbands facet.

PAGASA assigns local names to tropical cyclones entering the PAR, and TL/BIS (pangalan/ngalan; bagyo) match, but G8-E-7:philippines/source match PAGASA/Philippines while the competency is how typhoons develop and why PH is prone, not naming. G8-E-10:official-sources PAGASA is how authorities support affected communities (evacuat|relief|shelter|warning not admitted). Potential G8-E-8 or G8-E-10 after a naming/tracking-communication facet.

Rainbands as spiral rain-cloud bands around the eye is true, and TL/BIS (paikot na hanay / nagliko-liko nga laray; mata ng/sa bagyo) match, but G4-E-4 rain/clouds are weather descriptors (temperature/pressure/wind/humidity/rain/cloud cover), not typhoon anatomy. G3-M-1/G3-E-1 rain/cloud are local events/school earth materials. G3-E-9 eye is sun safety. Potential G8-E-7 after a rainbands/typhoon-parts facet.

Eye, eyewall, and rainbands are the three main parts, and TL/BIS keep those terms, but G8-E-7 is not admitted. G4-E-4 rain is weather-element identification. G3-M-1 rain is local everyday events. G3-E-9 eye/shade is sun safety. Potential G8-E-7 after a typhoon-parts facet.

Ube (Dioscorea alata) is a purple yam used in Filipino desserts, and TL/BIS (ugat na kulay-lila / gamot nga purpura; halaya) match, but G5-L-7 specialized structures is not admitted (needs rhizome, potato+tuber excluding sweet potato, thorn, bulb, or aerial root). G3-L-3 grow is the living-thing growth characteristic, not underground storage location. G3-L-5 roots is not admitted. Potential G5-L-7 after a yam/underground-storage facet.

The farad is named for Michael Faraday, and TL/BIS keep farad/Faraday/capacitance, but G7-M-7:units is making measurements in meter/gram/second/liter during investigations, not SI-unit etymology. G5-E-10/G6-E-5/G7-E-6 after are cyclone/volcano/earthquake actions. Potential G7-M-7 or G9-F after a capacitance/farad facet.

Household electrical energy is measured in kWh, and TL/BIS (konsumo ng kuryente / konsumo sa koryente; kWh) match. G8-F-7:units matches watt inside kilowatt-hours but the competency is power as the rate of doing work, not the energy unit. G10-F-9 electric-meter/kilowatt-meter is not admitted. G10-F-12 is reducing household electrical energy, not measuring it. G8-M-3/G8-M-6 symbol is element/subatomic symbols. Potential G10-F-9 after a kWh/meter facet.

The pascal (Pa) is named for Blaise Pascal, and TL/BIS keep pascal/presyon/presyur, but G7-M-7 is investigation measurements. G4-E-4:pressure is weather air pressure as a weather element. G3-M-8 press is shaping solids. Potential G4-E-4 or G7-M-7 after an SI-pressure-unit facet.

Upcycling waste into higher-value products is real. G4-M-6:waste admits the word waste but the card defines upcycling, not a community waste problem; G4-M-6:solutions (treat|recycl|compost) does not admit. G3-M-7:reuse does not admit (upcycling≠reuse). G3-M-6:trash is harmful disposal. G3-E-2 wood-furniture is dropped in TL/BIS (bags from rice sacks only). Potential G4-M-6 or G3-M-7 after an upcycle/reuse facet.

NASA's planetary comparison table lists Uranus g ≈ 8.7 m/s² vs Earth 9.8 (NSSDC; 1-bar mean 9.01, equatorial 8.69), and TL/BIS keep those figures. G8-E-11:gravity is Earth-Moon-Sun tides. G8-F-9:gravity is energy conservation when objects fall. G5-F-2 surfaces is a friction investigation. G5-F-4 non-contact is not admitted. Potential G5-F-4 or G8-F-9 after a planetary-g comparison facet.

Urine is mostly water plus wastes, and TL/BIS (ihi halos tubig / dumi/hugaw mula sa dugo) match, but G8-L-2 kidney/excretion pairing is not admitted. G4-L-1 systems are not admitted. G3-L-6/G4-E-2 water is basic needs, not urine composition. G3-M-6/G4-M-6 waste is environmental trash. Potential G8-L-2 after a urine/excretion-composition facet.

44.72 km/h peak from the 2009 Berlin 100 m 10 m splits is the widely cited figure, and TL/BIS keep 44.72 kilometro kada oras. G4-F-4 is constructing speed graphs, not a single trivia speed (graph activity not credited). G7-F-6 is speed vs velocity vectors. G7-F-4 is unbalanced forces changing speed. G7-M-7 meter is investigation units. Potential G4-F-4 or G7-F-6 after a human running-speed example facet.

~24 h spin and ~365 d orbit are the school figures, and TL/BIS (24 oras / 365 adlaw) match, but G6-E-7:rotation is not admitted (needs rotat, not spins); the globe/lamp model is not taught. Potential G6-E-7 after a spin/rotation synonym facet.

A whale shark eating only tiny plankton is a living-things-depend-on-one-another-for-food example, the only admitted G3-L-7 facet (food-and-shelter). G5-L-4:fish (gill|fin|scale) is not admitted. Venom delivery via fangs, stingers, or barbs is real, and TL/BIS (pangil/ngipon; tibo; tumutusok/motusok) match, but G3-L-4 feeding (beak|mouth|teeth|tongue) is not admitted. Venom can defend small animals against larger enemies (also used in predation; the defense use is true), and TL/BIS (kamandag/lala; ipagtanggol/manalipod) match, but G5-L-9 camouflage/mimicry is not admitted. G6-L-8 living-interactions predat is not admitted. G4-E-2 animals is water as a need. Potential G5-L-9 after a venom-defense adaptation facet.

NASA's planetary comparison table lists Venus g = 8.9 m/s² vs Earth 9.8 (NSSDC 8.87), and TL/BIS keep those figures. G8-E-11 is Earth-Moon-Sun tides. G8-F-9 is energy conservation when objects fall. G5-F-2 surfaces is a friction investigation. G5-F-10 strong is electromagnet. G5-F-4 non-contact is not admitted. Potential G5-F-4 after a planetary-g comparison facet.
